@Bettina Kroll: Moss's digest of Sunday 2 November 2025 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics' account ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." That is the date for the tracker.

The digest is written in advance, so it confirms the planned handoff date, not that it happened. It also doesn't name Kwame as the new owner. Kwame is the one who ran the port account in later channel posts, so that fits, but I'd confirm with Kwame or Ruth before recording "officially" in the tracker.
